مُسْرِفٌ [Exceeding, or transgressing, the just, or
right, bound, or limit, or measure; acting extravagantly, &c.: see its verb (4)]. ―
-b2- See also سَرِفٌ. ―
-b3- [Also] Denying, or disacknowledging, the favours, or benefits, or the unity, and the prophets and law, of God; a disbeliever, an unbeliever, or an infidel: it is said to be used in this sense in the Kur xl. 36. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
